newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Toco slumps into H1 loss, sees recovery.
newsitem.headline: Toco slumps into H1 loss, sees recovery.

text.p: NOTE - South Africa's Toco Holdings Ltd is an industrial holdings group.
The firm said the slip into the red was mainly due to major provisions and write-offs. It said provisions and write-offs for the interim period totalled 5.4 million rand.
However, it said it saw a return to profitability by March 1997 as all its local operations had healthy order books.

The firm added it was also set to get a boost from a recent $1.5 million deal that saw it take 100 percent ownership of its U.S. parking business Park Plus. "We expect that this offshore business will contribute substantially to profits within the next three to four years," the firm said.
